proposals.title: Item 5 Shareholder Proposal – Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to replace supermajority voting requirements in charter and bylaws with a majority of votes cast or simple majority standard.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 5).

proposals.title: Item 6 Shareholder Proposal – Report on Congruency of Political Spending
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing congruency between corporate values and electioneering and public-policy contributions, listing misaligned contributions.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal (Item 6).
